sovereign_country.strategic_role: 西欧核心消费市场、高客单价品牌合规与本土清关

business_scope.primary_industry_name: Printed Circuit Board Assembly and Surface-Mount Contract Assembly

incorporation_legal_framework.governing_statute_and_sections: French Commercial Code (Code de commerce): Articles L.210-1 et seq. (general company law), L.223-1 to L.223-43 (SARL); Articles R.223-1 et seq. and R.123-101 et seq. (registration with the Register of Commerce and Companies); Ordinance No. 2023-77 of 8 February 2023 establishing the single digital filing portal (Guichet Unique).
incorporation_legal_framework.competent_registry_authority: Greffe du Tribunal de Commerce de Lyon (Commercial Court Registry maintaining the Register of Commerce and Companies, RCS), which receives the dossier electronically through the Guichet Unique des Formalités d'Entreprises at formalites.entreprises.gouv.fr.
incorporation_legal_framework.statutory_filing_instrument: Statuts (Articles of Association) together with the single Cerfa declarative form of incorporation, the depositary certificate, the legal announcement receipt, and the statement of beneficial owners.
incorporation_legal_framework.minimum_paid_up_capital_rule: France imposes no statutory minimum share capital for a SARL; the Statuts set the capital freely. At incorporation at least one-fifth (20%) of cash-subscribed capital must be paid up (Article L.223-7 of the Code de commerce). Funds must be deposited in a blocked account with a bank, a notary, or the Caisse des Dépôts et Consignations, evidenced by an attestation de dépôt des fonds, and are released to the manager only upon RCS registration. In-kind contributions must be fully transferred upon signature and require a statutory appraiser (commissaire aux apports) where the individual value exceeds EUR 30,000 or the aggregate value exceeds half of the share capital.
incorporation_legal_framework.pro_forma_first_board_resolution_en: FIRST BOARD (ASSOCIATES) RESOLUTION — RESOLVED: (1) that the incorporators adopt the Articles of Association (Statuts) of France Precision Circuits SARL under Articles L.223-1 to L.223-43 of the French Commercial Code; (2) that the share capital of EUR 100,000, represented by 10,000 shares with a par value of EUR 10 each, be fully subscribed and paid up to at least one-fifth in accordance with Article L.223-7; (3) that the registered office be established at 12 Rue de la République, 69002 Lyon, and the incorporation notice be published in an authorized Journal d'Annonces Légales; (4) that Mr. Jean-Pierre Lambert be appointed Gérant for an indefinite term with full powers of representation and management; and (5) that all formalities be completed with the Guichet Unique and the RCS of Lyon. UNANIMOUSLY APPROVED.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Preparation and execution of the Statuts with registered-office proof
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Founding shareholders; optional but recommended assistance of a notary for certified execution
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Verify the availability of the proposed corporate name at the INPI data base (data.inpi.fr), draft and execute the Statuts, obtain a written domiciliation agreement or lease for the registered office, and collect original identity documents and sworn declarations of no disqualification from each manager.
required_dossiers: Draft Statuts (Articles of Association)
INPI name-search certificate
Registered-office domiciliation agreement or property lease
Valid identity documents of all founding shareholders and the Gérant
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the INPI name search reveals an identical or confusing prior mark, select an alternative corporate name and re-run the search; any defect in the executed Statuts is cured by a supplementary rectification deed (acte rectificatif) signed by all shareholders.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Deposit of the paid-up share capital and issuance of the depositary certificate
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Commercial bank, notary, or Caisse des Dépôts et Consignations (CDC)
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Open a temporary blocked account in the company name, transfer the subscribed cash contributions, and obtain the attestation de dépôt des fonds (certificate of deposit). The funds remain frozen until the RCS registration is obtained; in-kind contributions are listed in the Statuts and fully placed at the company's disposal at signature.
required_dossiers: Signed Statuts
Identity documents and bank account statements of contributing shareholders
Proof of registered office (domiciliation agreement)
Statement of in-kind contributions and valuation report where applicable
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the bank challenges the depositary instructions or the paying-in slips are incomplete, recommence the wire transfer and obtain a corrected attestation from the depositary; any dispute on valuation of in-kind contributions is resolved by a court-appointed commissioner (commissaire aux apports).

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Publication of the incorporation notice in a legal announcements gazette
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Journal d'Annonces Légales (JAL) authorized in the arrondissement of the registered office (e.g., Lyon)
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Submit the announcement text containing the corporate name, legal form, share capital, registered-office address, corporate object, the Gérant's identity, and the RCS city where registration is sought; pay the publication tariff and obtain the attestation de parution.
required_dossiers: Completed JAL announcement form
Extract of the Statuts showing the mandatory legal particulars
Attestation de parution issued by the gazette
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the gazette requests corrections or the published notice contains a factual error, publish a corrective notice (avis rectificatif) and obtain a revised publication certificate before the RCS filing.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Electronic filing of the incorporation dossier through the Guichet Unique
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Guichet Unique des Formalités d'Entreprises (formalites.entreprises.gouv.fr) transmitting to the Greffe du Tribunal de Commerce, INSEE, URSSAF, and the tax administration
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Create the declarant account on the portal, complete the Cerfa statutory form, upload all supporting documents in PDF format, declare the beneficial owners, and pay the registry fees online. The Greffe examines the dossier and registers the company under its RCS number, upon which INSEE issues the SIREN and SIRET identifiers.
required_dossiers: Signed Statuts
Attestation de dépôt des fonds (capital depositary certificate)
Attestation de parution from the JAL
Declaration of beneficial owners (bénéficiaires effectifs) with supporting identification
Copy of identity document and proof of address of the Gérant
Sworn statement of the Gérant that no legal disqualification applies
Registered-office domiciliation or lease agreement
Powers of attorney for any mandated representative
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the Greffier issues a request for additional documents (demande de pièces complémentaires), the statutory five-day review period is suspended until the missing documents are uploaded; if registration is refused, the applicant may summon the judge empowered to supervise the RCS (juge commis à la surveillance du registre) within 15 days of notification, and the judge can order the registration to proceed.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Post-registration confirmation and issuance of corporate identity documents
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Greffe du Tribunal de Commerce and INSEE
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Verify the RCS registration, retrieve the Extrait K-bis (official corporate proof), the SIREN/SIRET numbers, and the NAF code; obtain a company seal and open the definitive corporate bank account; notify the social and tax administrations of the active status.
required_dossiers: RCS registration number and K-bis extract
SIREN/SIRET assignment notices from INSEE
Company seal certification where applicable
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the K-bis extract or SIRET identifiers are not generated automatically, contact the Guichet Unique support desk for data reconciliation and, if needed, apply to the Greffe for a certified duplicate K-bis extract.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.competent_industrial_authority: DREAL (Direction Régionale de l'Environnement, de l'Aménagement et du Logement) - Inspection des Installations Classées, acting under the authority of the Préfet du Rhône for ICPE declaration or registration of solvent-using electronics manufacturing operations.
industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.operating_license_title: ICPE (Installations Classées pour la Protection de l'Environnement) - Récépissé de Déclaration or Arrêté Préfectoral d'Enregistrement covering rubric 2925 (surface pre-treatment and solvent application) and ancillary rubric 2563 (spraying and cleaning) applicable to PCBA line operations.

environmental_impact_assessment_eia.agency_name: DREAL - Inspection des Installations Classées, delegating authority of the Ministry of Ecological Transition and Territorial Cohesion
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.classification_tier: Category 'Déclaration' (Declarative) or 'Enregistrement' (Registration) under ICPE; the obligation to submit a full EIA is assessed on a case-by-case basis (examen au cas par cas) and is triggered only when production capacity or solvent consumption exceeds the Autorisation thresholds of the relevant rubric.
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.discharge_and_emissions_standards: Compliance with the ministerial order of 2 February 1998 on emissions of authorised ICPE installations: effluent pH between 5.5 and 8.5, temperature below 30°C, total suspended solids below 30 mg/L, chemical oxygen demand below 125 mg/L, and BOD5 below 30 mg/L; EU Directive 2011/65/EU (RoHS) and REACH (EC 1907/2006) restrictions on lead and restricted flux substances; solvent-emission limit values and monitoring of solvent-consumption thresholds under the Industrial Emissions Directive 2010/75/EU for vapour-degreasing and cleaning operations.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.civil_defense_and_occupational_clearance: Fire-safety and civil-defense compliance with the Labor Code (Code du travail) and the departmental fire authority (SDIS), including building evacuation certification, fire detection, and the intervention plan; structural load certification by an approved technical control office (Bureau de Contrôle) confirming floor capacity of at least 5 kN/m² for the SMT and wave-soldering lines; occupational health and workplace clearance delivered by the Inspection du Travail with the intervention of CARSAT and the occupational-medicine doctor, covering passive compliance with ESD protection areas, fume extraction, and medical-fitness checks for operators.

national_tax_registration_infrastructure.competent_tax_authority: Direction Générale des Finances Publiques (DGFiP), Ministry of Economy, Finance and Industrial and Digital Sovereignty; online portal impots.gouv.fr; e-invoicing portal Chorus Pro / Portail Public de Facturation (PPF)
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.tax_id_procurement_sop: A French SARL is incorporated through the Centre de Formalités des Entreprises (CFE) or the single electronic portal formalites.entreprises.gouv.fr; the CFE files the company formation dossier with the RCS and DGFiP, which then allocates SIREN/SIRET and, where applicable, a French TVA intracommunautaire number (FR + OCR). For a non-resident foreign entity without a French establishment, VAT identification is filed directly with the DGFiP non-resident taxpayer unit using the dedicated form (cerfa 1598-SD), accompanied by constitutive documents, proof of foreign tax residence and, when required by Article 302 D CGI, a French fiscal representative. The representative must be established in France and approved by DGFiP. Processing generally takes two to four weeks from submission of a complete file.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.statutory_election_mechanisms: France does not apply a US-style check-the-box election. A SARL is by default opaque and subject to French corporate income tax (impôt sur les sociétés) under CGI Article 206/219. A qualifying small or family SARL may elect for pass-through income tax treatment under CGI Article 239 bis AA (SARL de famille) for a five-year irrevocable period. No hybrid mismatch election is available; anti-hybrid rules apply under CGI Article 205 quinquies B (ATAD II).

indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.indirect_tax_system_name: Value Added Tax — Taxe sur la Valeur Ajoutée (TVA), transposing EU Directive 2006/112/EC into CGI Articles 256 to 308
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.statutory_registration_threshold_local_c: French-established taxpayers benefit from the small-business VAT exemption (franchise en base de TVA) up to EUR 85,000 of annual turnover for supplies of goods and EUR 37,500 for supplies of services. For a non-established foreign taxable person, no de minimis registration threshold applies: registration is required before the first taxable supply in France. Intra-EU distance sales thresholds are EUR 10,000 per calendar year unless the Union OSS scheme is elected.
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.electronic_invoicing_and_clearance_manda: France has implemented a sequenced e-invoicing mandate. All established taxable persons must issue B2B e-invoices using a certified dematerialisation platform (PDP) or the public portal PPF/Chorus Pro: from 1 September 2026 for large and mid-size enterprises, and from 1 September 2027 for small and micro enterprises. Structured formats (Factur-X, UBL, CII) and API transmission to the PPF are required. E-reporting of transaction and payment data is mandatory in parallel. There is no physical digital stamping or real-time pre-clearance approval; data is transmitted in near-real time for tax authority audit clearance.

export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.zero_rating_eligibility: Zero-rating applies to supplies of goods physically exported from the French customs territory to a destination outside the EU, provided title passes to the non-EU customer and the exporter retains documentary proof of removal from the Union. Under CGI Article 262 and BOI-TVA-CHAMP-40-10, the export declaration must be lodged with the French customs authorities and transport documents must demonstrate departure. B2B services supplied to third-country customers are outside the scope of French VAT where the place-of-supply rule points to the customer's establishment (CGI Article 259-1 B), unless the service is connected with French real property; contract assembly services performed on tangible goods may be zero-rated as part of an export supply when the goods are destined for the non-EU buyer.
mandatory_customs_documentation_bundle: Customs Export Declaration (DAU/SAD) with movement reference number (MRN), EORI number and AES/Export Control System release record
Bill of Lading, Sea Waybill, CMR road consignment note, or Air Waybill evidencing physical departure from the EU customs territory
Commercial invoice, export packing list, sales contract and purchase order
Inward Remittance Certificate or SWIFT MT103 bank confirmation evidencing receipt and FX repatriation of export proceeds
Freight engagement and carrier instruction records proving the goods were exported by or on behalf of the French supplier
VAT zero-rating substantiation file containing export attestations and the taxpayer's internal checklist under BOI-TVA-CHAMP-40-10
export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.audit_scrutiny_and_clawback_penalties: The French tax administration applies strict documentary scrutiny to export zero-rating claims. Failure to produce the mandatory customs and transport documentation within thirty days of an information request triggers reversal of the 0% rate and reassessment at 20% VAT, plus late-payment interest and a 5% penalty for late filing under CGI Article 1788 A. Deliberate or fraudulent claims attract an additional 40% penalty (mauvaise foi) or 80% penalty (manœuvres frauduleuses), and criminal tax fraud under CGI Article 1741 is punishable by a fine of up to EUR 500,000 and five years’ imprisonment. The DGFiP may also apply the abuse-of-law procedure under Book of Tax Procedure Article L.64 to disregard artificial arrangements created to obtain export VAT benefits.

fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.central_bank_authority: Banque de France (BdF), acting as the French central bank and statistical agent for the European Central Bank, in conjunction with the Direction Generale du Tresor (French Treasury) of the Ministere de l'Economie, des Finances et de la Souverainete industrielle et numerique, which holds the regulatory authority for foreign-exchange and foreign-investment control, and the Autorite de Controle Prudentiel et de Resolution (ACPR), which licenses and supervises credit institutions and payment institutions.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.currency_convertibility_assessment: France is a euro-area member with fully liberalized capital and current accounts under Article 63 TFEU and Articles L.151-1 et seq. of the Code monetaire et financier; there are no convertibility quotas, bilateral payment agreements, or exchange-control approvals blocking euro conversion for a French-resident SARL. The practical remittance constraint is fiscal, not regulatory: dividends paid by a French SARL to a non-resident corporate shareholder are subject to French withholding tax under CGI Article 119 bis 2 at 25%, reducible to 0% under the EU Parent-Subsidiary Directive (Directive 2011/96/EU) where the parent EU company holds at least 5% of the SARL for at least 2 years, or to a lower treaty rate for non-EU shareholders (e.g., 5% or 10% under the applicable China-France income tax treaty). Foreign investors may freely inject equity and debt into the SARL, subject only to statistical reporting to the BdF and, for non-EU investors, to the FDI screening regime of Article L.151-2 et seq. CMF, which does not normally capture commercial PCB assembly unless the buyer or end-use is in a strategic defense or critical-infrastructure sector.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.export_proceeds_surrender_rules: France imposes no mandatory surrender, conversion, or repatriation timeline on export proceeds; a French exporter may hold foreign-currency receivables in authorized foreign-currency accounts at ACPR-licensed banks. However, export collections must be channeled through an authorized intermediary credit institution under Article L.511-1 CMF, and the receiving bank automatically reports the transaction to the BdF balance-of-payments system for statistical and compliance purposes. There is no statutory conversion ratio, but transactions exceeding EUR 750,000 in a calendar month trigger the BdF's direct-investment and financial-flow declaration framework, and the SARL must be able to evidence the underlying export sale (invoice, transport document, customs declaration, and proof of settlement) within the ordinary commercial payment terms stated in the contract.

tier1_domestic_commercial_banks.bank_name: Credit Agricole CIB and regional caisses (e.g., Credit Agricole Ile-de-France)
BPCE S.A. network (Banque Populaire Rives de Paris / Caisse d'Epargne Ile-de-France / Natixis)

corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.fintech_emi_cross_border_viability: France permits ACPR-licensed electronic-money institutions and payment institutions (e.g., Qonto, Shine, Lydia, Treezor) to open operational IBAN-based accounts and execute SEPA and SWIFT transfers; feasibility for use as a secondary operating account is Medium-High, but as a primary cross-border treasury rail for a PCBA contract manufacturer the feasibility is Low. Legal constraints: a French EMI cannot issue documentary letters of credit or guarantees, cannot provide trade finance or receivables discounting, cannot hold secured capital-escrow balances for share-capital constitution, and is not an 'authorized intermediary' for the full export-import collection and balance-of-payments reporting chain. Client funds must be safeguarded with a French credit institution, and correspondent clearing is routed through partner banks, adding latency and potential intermediary fees for USD, CNY, and exotic-currency flows.
corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.physical_presence_and_kyc_interview_mand: Physical presence is generally mandatory for the SARL's gerant (manager) and for each shareholder holding 10% or more, at least for the initial relationship-opening interview under the ACPR's KYC doctrine. Remote video identification is accepted at the discretion of the bank for co-signatories or secondary directors, but not for the primary UBO in most mainstream French banks. For non-resident managers and shareholders, the bank requires: an in-person meeting at the branch, original valid passport, presentation of the RNE/Kbis extract, apostilled or notarially certified incorporation documents, proof of residential address, professional/income references, and a banker's reference letter from the parent company's home bank. Practical planning should allow 60 days from document delivery to final account activation.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Non-resident parent funding the SARL's entire share capital without local banking history and without a French credit footprint.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Current RNE/Kbis extract, certified articles of association, parent's audited financial statements for the last 2 years, 12 months of parent bank statements, board resolution approving the capital increase, signed source-of-funds declaration, ownership chart to the ultimate beneficial owner(s), and a projected 12-month cash-flow statement from the SARL.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Gerant or majority shareholder being a non-French resident or a person connected to a jurisdiction with elevated AML/CFT sensitivity.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Original passport, French residence permit or equivalent visa, official criminal-record certificate from the country of residence, proof of professional activity (pay slips, tax return, professional references), and a signed source-of-wealth statement supported by bank or investment statements covering at least 12 months.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Cross-border payments to suppliers in jurisdictions with partial currency controls or sanctions ambiguity (e.g., mainland China, Hong Kong, Belarus, Russia), including suspected re-invoicing or dual-use electronic components.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Per-transaction bundle composed of signed purchase order, supplier commercial invoice, packing list, bill of lading or airway bill, customs export declaration, stated Incoterms, final-destination certificate, end-user declaration, and, where applicable, classification under Annex I of EU Regulation 2021/821 for dual-use goods (ECCN categories 3A991, 3A992); a signed undertaking to notify the bank of any change of goods' end-use.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Use of shareholder current accounts (comptes courants d'associes) to fund working capital or cross-border payments, raising suspicion of disguised lending or unregulated money transmission.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Dated and notarized shareholder loan agreement, board resolution authorizing the loan, statement of account evidencing the receivable, arm's-length interest documentation, declaration of the loan in the SARL's annual tax filing (form 2777), and confirmation that the lender is not a state-controlled or politically exposed entity.

cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.inbound_capital_injection_routing: All inbound capital must be routed through an ACPR-authorized French bank. Recommended protocol: the parent's bank sends an SWIFT MT103 with beneficiary details as the SARL's French IBAN and BIC, clear reference in field 70 'CAPITAL INCREASE - DIRECT INVESTMENT', and a purpose code corresponding to the BdF balance-of-payments category for direct investment (equity capital); the French beneficiary bank must receive a copy of the shareholders' resolution, the capital attestation, and the RNE/Kbis extract before crediting the blocked capital account. If cumulative flows exceed EUR 750,000 in a calendar month, the bank files the direct-investment declaration with the BdF under Article L.151-2 CMF. For shareholder loans, execute a formal loan agreement with arm's-length interest, file the loan in the SARL's annual tax return (form 2777), and note that French withholding tax of 25% may apply to interest paid to a non-resident lender unless a treaty reduces or eliminates it. If the SARL itself maintains any foreign bank account abroad, it must be declared annually to the DGFiP via form 3916-bis.
cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.outbound_trade_disbursements: For the PCBA contract-manufacturing model, two primary clearing rails apply: (i) SWIFT MT103 telegraphic transfers for pre-shipment deposits, milestone payments, and settlement of open-account balances in EUR, USD, or CNY; and (ii) irrevocable documentary letters of credit issued under UCP600 via SWIFT MT700 for large component consignments or where the Asian supplier requires bank confirmation. The French bank will apply EU sanctions screening, dual-use goods controls under EU Regulation 2021/821, and standard anti-money-laundering checks; the SARL must present the underlying purchase order, commercial invoice, packing list, transport documents, Incoterms, and customs declarations for each transaction. For collection-based cross-border settlements, use documentary collection under URC 522 rather than open-account TT where payment risk is elevated. Bank-to-bank cover payments should be executed via MT202 COV, and foreign-currency concentration should be managed through a designated multi-currency account with daily sweep to the SARL's EUR treasury account to minimize leakage and FX conversion costs.
permissible_fx_hedging_instruments: Outright FX forward (change a terme) on EUR/USD, EUR/CNY, EUR/GBP, and EUR/HKD, with maturities matched to underlying trade invoices and purchase orders

European-style OTC FX options (EUR put / USD call, EUR put / CNY call) documented under an ISDA 2002 Master Agreement or the French bank's Convention-Cadre AFB, subject to MIFID II professional-client classification

FX swaps and cross-currency swaps (EUR/USD, EUR/CNY) for hedging balance-sheet exposures on shareholder loans and intercompany receivables, subject to EMIR and to the bilateral margining rules applicable to non-financial counterparties
Non-deliverable forwards (NDFs) on onshore CNY where the underlying trade invoice is denominated in CNY and the SARL's payment currency is EUR or USD, settled in EUR or USD

FX collar / zero-cost option combinations tailored to committed purchase-order cycles, provided the SARL meets the bank's suitability and appropriateness requirements under MIFID II and the FX positions qualify as hedges of commercial exposure rather than speculative trading

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual ordinary general meeting of shareholders approving the annual accounts and profit allocation (assemblée générale ordinaire annuelle)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Corporate statutory records / minute book; the approved accounts subsequently form part of the filing to the commercial court registry
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Within 6 months after the fiscal year-end; for a calendar-year SARL, by 30 June or the first business day thereafter if the due day is non-business.
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Failure to convene and approve accounts within the 6-month window exposes the manager to a court summons, judicial injunction and civil liability; profit distributions made without approved accounts may be challenged and pierced.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual corporate income tax return (déclaration de résultat – Form 2065-SD and liasse fiscale), including balance sheet, P&L, and annexes used by the tax administration
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Direction Générale des Finances Publiques (DGFiP) – Service des impôts des entreprises via EDI or EFI tele-filing
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: For a fiscal year ending 31 December, no later than 3 May of the following year for tele-filers; for other fiscal years, within three months of the fiscal year-end.
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Late filing triggers the automatic late-payment interest of 0.40% per month and a 5% late-filing penalty (raised to 10% where return is outstanding 30 days after formal notice); unpaid corporate income tax may be subject to enforced recovery and tax lien.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Corporate income tax balance liquidation declaration and payment (déclaration de liquidation et de solde de l'impôt sur les sociétés – Form 2571-SD)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: DGFiP – corporate income tax collection service (recette des impôts des entreprises)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Balance due on or before the 15th day of the 4th month after the fiscal year-end; for a calendar-year SARL, by 15 May. Quarterly instalments, where applicable, are due on 15 March, 15 June, 15 September and 15 December.
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Non-payment or under-payment attracts late-payment interest at 0.40% per month, a 5% general penalty after 30 days, and enforced recovery by the tax administration.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Deposit of annual accounts (comptes annuels) with the commercial company register, including balance sheet, income statement, supporting notes, management report and, where applicable, auditor's report
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Greffe du Tribunal de Commerce (Commercial Court Registry / RCS)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Within 7 months of the fiscal year-end and in any event within 1 month after shareholder approval; for a calendar-year SARL, by 31 July.
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Late or non-deposit may lead to a formal summons before the Tribunal de Commerce; the court can order the filing under a periodic penalty payment (astreinte) and impose a fine up to €3,000; persistent failure after formal notice can trigger administrative strike-off of the SARL from the RCS.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual confirmation of RCS data and beneficial owner information (confirmation annuelle des informations du RCS et des bénéficiaires effectifs)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Greffe du Tribunal de Commerce via Infogreffe / formalities portal
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Annually, aligned with the annual accounts filing window, i.e. within 7 months of the fiscal year-end; for a calendar-year SARL, by 31 July.
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Omission triggers a formal reminder from the registry; continued non-confirmation may block subsequent formalities and, after administrative notice, lead to forced deregistration (radiation) from the RCS and loss of good standing.

statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.compulsory_audit_thresholds: A statutory auditor (commissaire aux comptes) is mandatory for an SARL where, at the previous fiscal year-end, the company exceeds two of the following three thresholds: total balance sheet over €4,000,000; net turnover excluding VAT over €8,000,000; average number of employees over 50. An audit may also be required by minority shareholders or by the articles of association.
statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.governing_accounting_framework: French GAAP in accordance with the Plan Comptable Général and ANC Regulation n° 2014-03, as amended; IFRS is not used for the unconsolidated statutory accounts of an SARL unless specifically required in exceptional group/listed cases.

corporate_registers_and_ubo_annual_confi.ubo_annual_confirmation_protocol: The SARL must maintain a register of beneficial owners (Registre des bénéficiaires effectifs). The initial declaration is filed on incorporation and any change must be declared to the RCS within 15 days. Annually, as part of the RCS annual confirmation, the company must certify that the recorded beneficial owner information remains accurate. The declaration must identify each natural person who directly or indirectly holds more than 25% of capital or voting rights or exercises equivalent control.
